home.metaTitle: Onward Scout — Your scout for every opportunity
home.metaDescription: Drop in your résumé, deck or portfolio. Onward Scout finds real jobs, investors, grants, fellowships, competitions and programs you can win, prepares each application from your own facts and submits it after your tap.

hero.title: Your scout for every opportunity.
hero.lede: Drop in what you already have and tap the openings you want. We prepare and submit each application — you only look and tap at the moments that matter.

early.title: Early access — be one of the first.
early.body: Onward Scout is new. You won’t find user counts, logos or testimonials here, because we don’t have ones we’d stand behind yet. What we can show you is exactly how it works, and what it will and won’t do for you.

audiences.title: Built for whoever you are right now.
audiences.lede: One engine, one profile, one board — whether you’re after a first internship, a seed round or a research grant. Plenty of people are two of these at once; that works too.

finds.title: Every kind of opening, not just job ads.
finds.lede: Jobs and internships, yes — and the investors, accelerators, grants, fellowships, calls for papers, residencies and speaking slots most people never find the time to look for.

steps.title: From what you have to what you want, in six steps.
steps.lede: You drop in, confirm and tap. Everything between those moments is ours.

boundary.title: What we automate, and what stays with you.
boundary.lede: Some steps should never be automated: your logins, your signature, your payment, your interview. We design them as short, well-prepared handoffs instead of pretending they don’t exist.

final.title: Your next opening is already out there.
final.body: Drop in what you have. You’ll see what you can go after in minutes — free, and nothing is sent until you tap.

howItWorks.metaDescription: How Onward Scout turns your documents into a sourced profile, finds opportunities you can win, prepares and submits each application after your tap, and hands over the steps that must stay with you.
howItWorks.title: You bring what you have. We go ahead and find the way.
howItWorks.lede: Six steps from the documents on your laptop to applications submitted and followed up. You drop in, confirm and tap; we do everything in between, and we tell you plainly where we stop.

channels.title: How an application leaves.
channels.lede: The channel depends on where the opportunity lives. We use the most direct route that’s allowed, and fall back to a handoff when automation isn’t.

how.title: Three moments, one payment.
how.oneTitle: Drop your résumé on a programme
how.oneBody: Any listing has “Write my application”. In about two minutes you see the preview: your documents for that programme, drafted from your own files. Free, no account.
how.twoTitle: Unlock when it is worth it
how.twoBody: {price} once, by card. Claude then reads your résumé again in full and writes every document and answer for that posting, in about two minutes.
how.threeBody: Word and PDF, every form answer ready to copy, and the submission by us where the form allows it or a step-by-step handoff where it doesn’t. Change anything as often as you like.

billing.title: The money details.
billing.refundsBody: Within 14 days of a charge, if the application it unlocked was never downloaded or submitted, we refund it in full. Season passes: within 14 days if no application was unlocked with it.
billing.checkoutBody: Payments run on Stripe’s secure checkout; we never see your card number. Stripe emails your receipt. Prices are in US dollars.
billing.changeBody: Every payment is one-off: one application, or one 90-day season pass. Nothing renews, so there is nothing to cancel. Billing in your account lists every payment.

cta.title: Not sure yet? The preview costs nothing.
cta.body: Open a programme, drop your résumé and look at what comes back. {price} only when you want it written in full.

passes.title: One payment for a whole round
passes.lede: Going after one kind of programme this season? Pay once, unlock every application of that kind for 90 days, and it simply ends. No subscription to remember.
passes.note: A pass only pays for applications of its own kind and is used before any other credit for them.

contact.metaDescription: Write to Onward Scout about an application, your account, billing, privacy or a partnership. We reply to every message within two business days.
contact.title: Talk to a person.
contact.lede: About an application, your data, billing or a partnership: write to us and it reaches someone who can help.
contact.tip1: Account or billing question? Write from the email you sign in with, so we can find your account and receipts straight away.
contact.tip2: Privacy request? Export and deletion are in Settings; for anything else, choose “Privacy or my data”.
contact.tip3: Organisation? To list a program or connect directly, choose “Organisations and partnerships”.
